rationale: The agent found that the split is gene-disjoint but every one of the 26 test Pfam families also appears in train, so the 0.90 AUROC comes from reusing per-family label information. It declined to report 0.90 as general performance. It measured 100% family overlap, and its family-held-out CV result (0.38) supports the key's fix of splitting by family. It did not compute the family label-rate baseline, but the 100% overlap figure matches one of the key's quantify items.
